name: io.github.ianderso/snac-archives-mcp
title: SNAC Archives
description: Find which archive holds the papers: SNAC's index of archival collections, plus ArchiveGrid links.

environmentVariables.name: SNAC_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the on-disk response cache.

environmentVariables.name: SNAC_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. Holdings lists get 120 s of their own.

environmentVariables.name: SNAC_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL appended to the User-Agent, so SNAC can reach whoever runs the server.
